description: Second-order SSRF: unvalidated webhook subscriberUrl (API v1 _post.ts, no validateUrlForSSRF) persisted then dispatched via fetch() with no re-validation.
SSRF: CalDAV add-account fetches user-supplied req.body.url via listCalendars() with no SSRF validation; sibling-gap vs validated webhook paths.
Open redirect: return-to cookie value passed to NextResponse.redirect; new URL(value,base) ignores base, no getSafeRedirectUrl same-origin check.
SSRF (demoted): webhook dispatch fetch(subscriberUrl); tRPC/API v2 creation paths apply write-time validateUrlForSSRFSync; residual DNS-rebinding/self-hosted private-IP risk keeps it advisory.
SSRF (demoted): scheduled webhook dispatch fetch(job.subscriberUrl); tRPC/v2 creation paths validate at write-time; residual DNS-rebinding/self-hosted private-IP risk keeps it advisory.
Log injection: raw console.error logs a possibly second-order subscriberUrl without neutralizing CR/LF; real-world log-forging exploitability uncertain (stated, not a control).
Open redirect (advisory): redirect_url for NextResponse.redirect is computed inside third-party saml-jackson oauthController.authorize; attacker influence not confirmable in-repo; empty codeFlows.
Open redirect (demoted): /api/router computes a routed redirect destination via getRoutedUrl and returns it in JSON (not a 3xx); destination is form-owner configured; reachability uncertain (stated).
Auth decision: HitPay webhook verifies HMAC with non-constant-time 'signed !== obj.hmac' compare, unlike siblings using crypto.timingSafeEqual; a check is present (timing weakness only), advisory.
Auth decision: ApiAuthStrategy compares OAuth client secret with non-constant-time 'client.secret !== oAuthClientSecret'; a secret check is present (timing weakness only), advisory.
Auth decision: GoogleCalendarSubscription validates inbound X-Goog-Channel-Token with non-constant-time 'token !== GOOGLE_WEBHOOK_TOKEN'; a token check is present (timing weakness only), advisory.
Auth decision: throttler guard derives rate-limit identity from spoofable cf-connecting-ip header (fallback request.ip); impact is rate-limit evasion, deployment-dependent behind Cloudflare (stated).
Missing authorization: routing-forms 'response' mutation is bound as publicProcedure (no auth guard) and performs a write; whether a submitted field drives a privileged write is not established
Missing authorization: markHostAsNoShow is a publicProcedure that updates booking state (marks host no-show) via handleMarkHostNoShow, keyed only by attacker-suppliable bookingUid with no auth guard.
